name: Cat 5 - The Regent Who Bloomed Twice

specialLock.label: Seed Oath
specialLock.prompt: The pod asks what dead gardens want most.

customItems.name: Regent Seed
customItems.description: A heavy black seed. It pulses like a second chance and smells faintly of rain over graves.
customItems.customDescription: A heavy black seed. It pulses like a second chance and smells faintly of rain over graves.

intro.text: The forest buried its last regent under flowers. Now the flowers wear the regent. A village wants the black seed cut from the throne before the bloom learns to grow people on purpose.

outro.text: The Regent Seed quiets when carried into daylight. Behind you, the corpse flower bows once, not in defeat but in abdication.

storyTriggers.title: Toll of Leaves
storyTriggers.text: Leaves lie across the trail in rows like coins. Something in the brush waits for payment.

storyTriggers.title: Petal Court
storyTriggers.text: Petals drift from nowhere and arrange themselves into a crown before scattering underfoot.

storyTriggers.title: Root Prison
storyTriggers.text: Roots hold an animal crate shut. Whatever is inside growls at the plants, not at you.

storyTriggers.title: The Bloomed Regent
storyTriggers.text: The Corpse Flower Regent rises from a throne of old armor. Its petals open like a court full of mouths.

storyTriggers.title: The Seed Relents
storyTriggers.text: The pod parts at the word rain. The seed inside is dark, alive, and suddenly very small.

designNotes.twist: The boss is a regent-host; the real objective is the seed, not the kill.
designNotes.revision: Expanded to seven rooms and roughly 5-8 encounter rooms; hidden doors are one-sided from reachable rooms only.
